title: Python: Fix Mistral AI seed setting being rejected by the SDK

@@ -56,3 +56,15 @@ class MistralAIChatPromptExecutionSettings(MistralAIPromptExecutionSettings):
             "on the function choice configuration.",
         ),
     ] = None
+
+    def prepare_settings_dict(self, **kwargs) -> dict[str, Any]:
+        """Prepare the settings as a dictionary for sending to the AI service.
+
+        The Mistral SDK has no `seed` parameter, it takes `random_seed`, so `seed` is sent
+        as `random_seed` unless that one is set explicitly.
+        """
+        settings = super().prepare_settings_dict(**kwargs)
+        seed = settings.pop("seed", None)
+        if seed is not None:
+            settings.setdefault("random_seed", seed)
+        return settings

+def test_prepare_settings_dict_maps_seed_to_random_seed():
+    # The Mistral SDK has no `seed` parameter, only `random_seed`
+    settings = MistralAIChatPromptExecutionSettings(seed=42)
+    options = settings.prepare_settings_dict()
+    assert "seed" not in options
+    assert options["random_seed"] == 42
+
+
+def test_prepare_settings_dict_keeps_explicit_random_seed():
+    settings = MistralAIChatPromptExecutionSettings(seed=42, random_seed=7)
+    options = settings.prepare_settings_dict()
+    assert "seed" not in options
+    assert options["random_seed"] == 7
